```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
seed_val = 100
```

```{r}
poly_cnt = read_csv(here('data', 'raw', '2008_Mossong_POLYMOD_contact_common.csv'))
poly_part = read_csv(here('data', 'raw', '2008_Mossong_POLYMOD_participant_common.csv'))
# poly_cnt = read_csv('../../data/2008_Mossong_POLYMOD_contact_common.csv')
# poly_part = read_csv('../../data/2008_Mossong_POLYMOD_participant_common.csv')
```

```{r}
data_clean = function(df) {
  # cleaning datasets
  
  cleaned_df = df %>%
    mutate(
      cnt_age = case_when(
      !is.na(cnt_age_exact) ~ cnt_age_exact,
      
      !is.na(cnt_age_est_min) & !is.na(cnt_age_est_max) ~ (cnt_age_est_min + cnt_age_est_max) / 2,
      
      !is.na(cnt_age_est_min) & is.na(cnt_age_est_max) ~ cnt_age_est_min,
      
      is.na(cnt_age_est_min) & !is.na(cnt_age_est_max) ~ cnt_age_est_max,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ) 
    ) %>%
    select(-cnt_age_exact, -cnt_age_est_min, -cnt_age_est_max, -hh_id) %>%
    relocate(cnt_age, .after = cont_id) %>%
    relocate(c(part_age, part_gender), .after = part_id) %>%
    distinct(part_id, cont_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      phys_contact = coalesce(phys_contact, 2),       # if NA -> 0
      frequency_multi = coalesce(frequency_multi, 5), # if NA -> 5
      duration_multi = coalesce(duration_multi, 1)    # if NA -> 1
    )
  return(cleaned_df)
}
```

```{r}
poly_merged = poly_cnt %>%
  left_join(poly_part, by = 'part_id')

poly_df = data_clean(poly_merged)
```

```{r}
poly_df %>%
  summarize(
    cnt_age_missing_pct = sum(is.na(cnt_age)) / n() * 100,
    cnt_gender_missing_pct = sum(is.na(cnt_gender)) / n() * 100
  )
```

```{r}
poly_cnt %>%
  summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))
```

```{r}
poly_part %>%
  summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))
```

```{r}
poly_df %>%
  summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))
```

```{r}
poly_df = poly_df %>%
  drop_na(part_age) %>%
  drop_na(part_gender)
```

```{r}
poly_df %>%
  summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))
```

```{r}
poly_df = poly_df %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(cnt_school, cnt_work, cnt_home, cnt_transport, cnt_leisure), ~replace_na(., FALSE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    location_category = case_when(
      cnt_school == TRUE ~ "School", 
      cnt_work == TRUE   ~ "Work",   
      cnt_home == TRUE   ~ "Home",   
      cnt_transport == TRUE ~ "Transport",
      cnt_leisure == TRUE  ~ "Leisure",
      TRUE               ~ "Other"   
    )
  )
```

```{r}
reference_pool = poly_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(cnt_age)) %>% 
  group_by(part_age, location_category) %>% 
  summarise(
    age_pool = list(cnt_age),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(seed_val)

gender_probs = prop.table(table(poly_df$cnt_gender))

poly_imputed = poly_df %>%
  left_join(reference_pool, by = c('part_age', 'location_category')) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    cnt_age = if_else(
      is.na(cnt_age),
      if (is.null(age_pool) || length(age_pool) == 0) {
        part_age
      }
      else {
        sample(age_pool, 1)
      },
      cnt_age
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-age_pool) %>%
  mutate(
    cnt_gender = if_else(
      is.na(cnt_gender),
      sample(
        names(gender_probs),
        size = n(),
        replace = TRUE,
        prob = gender_probs
      ),
      cnt_gender
    )
  )
```

```{r}
poly_imputed %>%
  summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.))))
```
